hints.title: Subsequence Subset Sum Model
hints.text: This is a variant of the 0/1 knapsack problem where each item has weight nums[i] and value 1, aiming to maximize value at exact weight target.

hints.title: 1D State Array
hints.text: Let dp[t] denote the maximum length of a subsequence summing to t, initialized to -1 with dp[0] = 0.

hints.title: Reverse Iteration
hints.text: For each number x in nums, iterate t from target down to x to prevent using x multiple times.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Backtracking all subsequences takes O(2^n) which times out for n = 1000.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Proper backwards iteration to reuse 1D state array safely.
